Molten Egg.flavor: The egg of a Phoenix. It glows red hot with a simmering lava.

Mummified Hand.description: Whenever you play a Power card, a random card in your hand costs 0 that turn.
Mummified Hand.flavor: Frequently twitches, especially when your pulse is high.

Ornamental Fan.description: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 4 Block .
Ornamental Fan.flavor: The fan seems to extend and harden as blood is spilled.

Pantograph.description: At the start of Boss combats, heal 25 HP.
Pantograph.flavor: "Solid foundations are not accidental. Tools for planning are a must." - The Architect

Pear.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 10.
Pear.flavor: A common fruit before the Spireblight.

Question Card.description: Future card rewards have 1 additional card to choose from.
Question Card.flavor: "Those with more choices minimize the downside to chaos." - Kublai the Great

Shuriken.description: Every time you play 3 Attacks in a single turn, gain 1 Strength .
Shuriken.flavor: Lightweight throwing weapons. Recommend going for the eyes.

Singing Bowl.description: When adding cards to your deck, you may raise your Max HP by 2 instead.
Singing Bowl.flavor: This well-used artifact rings out with a beautiful melody when struck.

Sundial.description: Every 3 times you shuffle your draw pile, gain 2 Energy .
Sundial.flavor: "Early man's foolish obsession with time caused them to look to the sky for guidance, hoping for something permanent." - Zoroth

Teardrop Locket.flavor: Its owner blind, its contents unseen.

The Courier.description: The Merchant restocks cards , relics , and potions . All prices are reduced by 20%.

Toxic Egg.description: Whenever you add a Skill card to your deck, Upgrade it.
Toxic Egg.flavor: "What a marvelous discovery! This appears to be the inert egg of some magical creature. Who or what created this?" - Ranwid

White Beast Statue.description: Potions always appear in combat rewards.
White Beast Statue.flavor: A small white statue of a creature you have never seen before.

Paper Phrog.description: Enemies with Vulnerable take 75% more damage rather than 50%.
Paper Phrog.flavor: The paper continually folds and unfolds itself into the shape of a small creature.

Self-Forming Clay.description: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Block next turn.
Self-Forming Clay.flavor: "Most curious! It appears to form itself loosely on my thoughts! Tele-clay?" - Ranwid

Ninja Scroll.description: At the start each combat, add 3 Shivs into your hand.

Paper Krane.description: Enemies with Weak deal 40% less damage rather than 25%.
Paper Krane.flavor: An origami of a creature from a past age.

Gold-Plated Cables.description: Your rightmost Orb triggers its passive an additional time.
Gold-Plated Cables.flavor: "Interesting! Even automatons are affected by placebo." - Ranwid

Symbiotic Virus.description: At the start of each combat, Channel 1 Dark .
Symbiotic Virus.flavor: A little bit of bad can do a lot of good.

Bird-Faced Urn.description: Whenever you play a Power card, heal 2 HP.
Bird-Faced Urn.flavor: This urn shows the crow god Mazaleth looking mischievous.

Calipers.description: At the start of your turn, lose 15 Block rather than all of your Block .
Calipers.flavor: "Mechanical precision leads to greatness" - The Architect

Captain's Wheel.description: At the start of your 3rd turn, gain 18 Block .
Captain's Wheel.flavor: Wooden trinket carved with delicate precision. A name is carved into it but the language is foreign.

Cloak Clasp.description: At the end of your turn, gain 1 Block for each card in your hand.

Dead Branch.description: Whenever you Exhaust a card, add a random card to your hand.
Dead Branch.flavor: The branch of a tree from a forgotten era.

Du-Vu Doll.description: For each Curse in your deck, start each combat with 1 Strength .
Du-Vu Doll.flavor: A doll devised to gain strength from malicious energy.

Fossilized Helix.description: Prevent the first time you would lose HP in combat.
Fossilized Helix.flavor: Seemingly indestructible, you wonder what kind of creature this belonged to.

Gambling Chip.description: At the start of each combat, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards.
Gambling Chip.flavor: You can see a small inscription on one side. It reads: "Bear's Lucky Chip!"

Ginger.description: You can no longer become Weakened .
Ginger.flavor: A potent tool in many tonics.

Girya.description: You can now gain Strength at Rest Sites (up to 3 times).
Girya.flavor: This Girya is unfathomably heavy. You could train with this to get significantly stronger.

Golden Eye.description: Whenever you Scry , Scry 2 additional cards.
Golden Eye.flavor: See into the minds of those nearby, predicting their future moves.

Ice Cream.description: Energy is now conserved between turns.

Incense Burner.flavor: The smoke imbues its owner with the spirit of the burned.

Lizard Tail.description: When you would die, heal to 50% of your Max HP instead (works once).
Lizard Tail.flavor: A fake tail to trick enemies during combat.

Mango.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 14.
Mango.flavor: The most coveted forgotten fruit. Impeccably preserved with no signs of Spireblight.

Old Coin.flavor: Unique coins are highly valued by Merchants for their historical value and rare metallic composition.

Peace Pipe.description: You can now remove cards from your deck at Rest Sites.
Peace Pipe.flavor: Clears the mind and cleanses the soul.

Pocketwatch.description: Whenever you play 3 or less cards during your turn, draw 3 additional cards at the start of your next turn.
Pocketwatch.flavor: The hands seem stuck on the 3 o'clock position.

Prayer Wheel.description: Normal enemies drop an additional card reward.
Prayer Wheel.flavor: The wheel continues to spin, never stopping.

Shovel.description: You can now Dig for relics at Rest Sites.
Shovel.flavor: The Spire houses all number of relics from past civilizations and powerful adventurers lost to time. Time to go dig them up!

Stone Calendar.description: At the end of turn 7, deal 52 damage to ALL enemies.
Stone Calendar.flavor: The passage of time is imperceptible in the Spire.

Thread and Needle.description: At the start of each combat, gain 4 Plated Armor .
Thread and Needle.flavor: Wrapping the magical thread around your body, you feel harder to the touch.

Torii.description: Whenever you would receive 5 or less unblocked Attack damage, reduce it to 1.
Torii.flavor: Holding the small Torii, you feel a sense of calm and safety drift through your mind.

Tungsten Rod.description: Whenever you would lose HP, lose 1 less.

Turnip.description: You can no longer become Frail .

Unceasing Top.description: Whenever you have no cards in hand during your turn, draw a card.
Unceasing Top.flavor: The top continues to spin effortlessly as if you were in a dream.

Wing Boots.description: You may ignore paths when choosing the next room to travel to 3 times.

Champion Belt.description: Whenever you apply Vulnerable , also apply 1 Weak .
Champion Belt.flavor: Only the greatest may wear this belt.

Charon's Ashes.description: Whenever you Exhaust a card, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
Charon's Ashes.flavor: Charon was said to be the god of rebirth, eternally dying and reviving in a burst of flame.

Magic Flower.description: Healing is 50% more effective during combat.
Magic Flower.flavor: A flower long thought extinct, somehow preserved in perfect condition.

The Specimen.description: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any Poison it has to a random enemy.
The Specimen.flavor: "Fascinating! I found a mutated creature demonstrating astounding toxic properties. Storing a sample for later examination." - Ranwid

Tingsha.description: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
Tingsha.flavor: The sound this instrument generates seems to be capable of reverberating to painful levels of volume.

Tough Bandages.description: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, gain 3 Block .

Emotion Chip.description: If you lost HP during the previous turn, trigger the passive ability of all Orbs at the start of your turn.

Astrolabe.description: Upon pickup, Transform 3 cards, then Upgrade them.
Astrolabe.flavor: A tool to glean invaluable knowledge from the stars.

Black Star.description: Elites now drop an additional relic when defeated.
Black Star.flavor: Originally discovered in the town of the serpent, aside a solitary candle.

Busted Crown.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. Future card rewards have 2 less cards to choose from.
Busted Crown.flavor: The Champ's crown... or a pale imitation?

Calling Bell.description: Upon pickup, obtain a unique Curse and 3 relics.
Calling Bell.flavor: This dark iron bell rang 3 times when you found it, but now stays silent.

Coffee Dripper.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer Rest at Rest Sites.
Coffee Dripper.flavor: "Yes, another cup please. Back to work. Back to work!" - The Architect

Cursed Key.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. Whenever you open a non-Boss chest, obtain a Curse .
Cursed Key.flavor: You can feel the malicious energy emanating from the key. Power comes at a price.

Ectoplasm.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer gain Gold .
Ectoplasm.flavor: This blob of slime and energy seems to pulse with life.

Empty Cage.description: Upon pickup, remove 2 cards from your deck.
Empty Cage.flavor: "How unusual to cage that which you worship." - Ranwid

Fusion Hammer.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer Smith at Rest Sites.
Fusion Hammer.flavor: Once wielded, the owner can never let go.

Holy Water.description: Replaces Pure Water . At the start of each combat, add 3 Miracles into your hand.
Holy Water.flavor: Collected from a time before the Spire.

Pandora's Box.description: Upon pickup, Transform all Strike and Defend cards.
Pandora's Box.flavor: You have a bad feeling about opening this.

Philosopher's Stone.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. ALL enemies start combat with 1 Strength .
Philosopher's Stone.flavor: Raw energy emanates from the stone, empowering all nearby.

Runic Dome.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer see enemy intents.

Runic Pyramid.description: At the end of your turn, you no longer discard your hand.

Sacred Bark.flavor: A bark rumored to originate from the World tree.

Slaver's Collar.description: During Boss and Elite combats, gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn.

Snecko Eye.description: At the start of your turn, draw 2 additional cards. Start each combat Confused .
Snecko Eye.flavor: An eye of a fallen snecko. Much larger than you imagined.

Sozu.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You can no longer obtain potions .
Sozu.flavor: You notice that magical liquids seem to lose their properties when near this relic.

Tiny House.description: Upon pickup, obtain 1 Potion . Gain 50 Gold . Raise your Max HP by 5. Obtain 1 card. Upgrade 1 random card.
Tiny House.flavor: "A near perfect implementation of miniaturization. My finest work to date, but still not adequate." - The Architect

Velvet Choker.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. You cannot play more than 6 cards per turn.
Velvet Choker.flavor: "Immense power, but too limited." - Kublai the Great

Violet Lotus.description: Whenever you exit Calm , gain an additional Energy .
Violet Lotus.flavor: The old texts describe that the surface of "mana pools" were littered with these flowers.

Black Blood.description: Replaces Burning Blood . At the end of combat, heal 12 HP.

Mark of Pain.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, shuffle 2 Wounds into your draw pile.
Mark of Pain.flavor: This brand was used by the northern tribes to signify warriors who had mastered pain in battle.

Runic Cube.description: Whenever you lose HP, draw 1 card.

Hovering Kite.description: The first time you discard a card each turn, gain 1 Energy .
Hovering Kite.flavor: The Kite floats around you in battle, propelled by a mysterious force.

Ring of the Serpent.description: Replaces Ring of the Snake . At the start of your turn, draw 1 additional card.
Ring of the Serpent.flavor: Your ring has morphed and changed forms.

Wrist Blade.description: Attacks that cost 0 deal 4 additional damage.

Frozen Core.description: Replaces Cracked Core . If you end your turn with any empty Orb slots, Channel 1 Frost .
Frozen Core.flavor: The crack in your core has been filled with a pulsating cold energy.

Nuclear Battery.description: At the start of each combat, Channel 1 Plasma .

Cauldron.flavor: The Merchant is actually a rather skilled potion brewer. Buy 4 get 1 free.

Chemical X.description: The effects of your cost X cards are increased by 2.
Chemical X.flavor: WARNING: Do not combine with sugar, spice, and everything nice.

Dolly's Mirror.description: Upon pickup, obtain an additional copy of a card in your deck.

Frozen Eye.description: When viewing your Draw Pile, the cards are now shown in order.
Frozen Eye.flavor: Staring into the eye, you see a glimpse of your future.

Hand Drill.description: Whenever you break an enemy's Block , apply 2 Vulnerable .

Lee's Waffle.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 7 and heal all of your HP.
Lee's Waffle.flavor: "Tastiest treat you will find in all the Spire! Baked today just for you."

Medical Kit.description: Unplayable Status cards can now be played. Whenever you play a Status card, Exhaust it.
Medical Kit.flavor: "Has everything you need! Anti-itch, anti-burn, anti-venom, and more!"

Melange.description: Whenever you shuffle your draw pile, Scry 3.
Melange.flavor: Mysterious sands from an unknown origin. Smells of cinnamon.

Membership Card.flavor: "Bonus membership offer for my most valuable customers!"

Orange Pellets.description: Whenever you play a Power , Attack , and Skill in the same turn, remove all of your debuffs .
Orange Pellets.flavor: Made from various fungi found throughout the Spire, they will stave off any affliction.

Orrery.description: Upon pickup, choose and add 5 cards to your deck.

Prismatic Shard.description: Combat reward screens now contain Colorless cards and cards from other colors.
Prismatic Shard.flavor: Looking through the shard, you are able to see entirely new perspectives.

Sling of Courage.description: Start each Elite combat with 2 Strength .
Sling of Courage.flavor: A handy tool for dealing with particularly tough opponents.

Strange Spoon.description: Cards which Exhaust when played will instead discard 50% of the time.
Strange Spoon.flavor: Staring at the spoon, it appears to bend and twist around before your eyes.

The Abacus.description: Whenever you shuffle your draw pile, gain 6 Block .

Toolbox.description: At the start of each combat, choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards and add the chosen card into your hand.

Brimstone.description: At the start of your turn, gain 2 Strength and ALL enemies gain 1 Strength .

Twisted Funnel.description: At the start of each combat, apply 4 Poison to ALL enemies.
Twisted Funnel.flavor: I wouldn't drink out of it.

Runic Capacitor.description: Start each combat with 3 additional Orb slots.

Bloody Idol.description: Whenever you gain Gold , heal 5 HP.
Bloody Idol.flavor: The idol now weeps a constant stream of blood.

Enchiridion.description: At the start of each combat, add a random Power card into your hand. It costs 0 for that turn.
Enchiridion.flavor: The legendary journal of an ancient lich.

Face of Cleric.description: At the end of combat, raise your Max HP by 1.

Golden Idol.flavor: Made of solid gold, you feel richer just holding it.

Mark of the Bloom.flavor: In the Beyond, thoughts and reality are one.

Mutagenic Strength.description: Start each combat with 3 Strength . At the end of your first turn, lose 3 Strength .
Mutagenic Strength.flavor: "The results seem fleeting, triggering when the subject is in danger." - Unknown

N'loth's Gift.description: Triples the chance of finding Rare cards from combat rewards.
N'loth's Gift.flavor: The strange gift from N'loth. Whenever you try and unwrap it, another wrapped box of the same size lies within.

N'loth's Hungry Face.description: The next non-Boss chest you open is empty.

Necronomicon.description: The first Attack played each turn that costs 2 or more is played twice. Upon pickup, obtain a special Curse .
Necronomicon.flavor: Only a fool would try and harness this evil power. At night your dreams are haunted by images of the book devouring your mind.

Neow's Lament.description: Enemies in your first 3 combats will have 1 HP.
Neow's Lament.flavor: The blessing of lamentation bestowed by Neow.

Nilry's Codex.description: At the end of each turn, you may shuffle 1 of 3 random cards to shuffle into your draw pile.
Nilry's Codex.flavor: Crafted by the infamous game master himself. Said to expand one's mind.

Odd Mushroom.description: When Vulnerable , take 25% more attack damage rather than 50%.
Odd Mushroom.flavor: "After consuming trichella parastius I felt larger and less... susceptible." - Ranwid

Red Mask.description: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies.
Red Mask.flavor: This very stylish looking mask belongs to the leader of the Red Mask Bandits. Technically that makes you the leader now?

Spirit Poop.flavor: The charred remains of your offering to the spirits.

Ssserpent Head.description: Whenever you enter a ? room, gain 50 Gold .
Ssserpent Head.flavor: The most fulfilling of lives is that in which you can buy anything!

Warped Tongs.description: At the start of your turn, Upgrade a random card in your hand for the rest of combat.
Warped Tongs.flavor: The cursed tongs emit a strong desire to return to where they were stolen from.

Accursed.description: Whenever you defeat a Boss, obtain 2 random Curses .

Ancient Augmentation.description: Enemies start combat with 1 Artifact , 10 Plated Armor , and 10 Regenerate .

Mimic Infestation.description: Treasure rooms in future acts are replaced by Elites. Elites no longer drop Relics.

Muzzle.description: You can no longer increase your Max HP. All healing is halved.

Time Maze.description: You cannot play more than 15 cards per turn.

Twisting Mind.description: At the end of your turn, add 1 random Status card to the top of your draw pile.

Circlet.description: Collect as many as you can.
Circlet.flavor: You ran out of relics to find. Impressive!

Red Circlet.description: You ran out of relics. Impressive!

Attack Potion.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Attack cards to add ( two copies of it ) to your hand. It costs ( They cost ) 0 this turn.

Blessing of the Forge.description: Upgrade all cards in your hand for the rest of combat.

Colorless Potion.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Colorless cards to add ( 2 copies of ) to your hand. It costs ( They cost ) 0 this turn.

Flex Potion.description: Gain 5 ( 10 ) Strength . At the end of your turn, lose 5 ( 10 ) Strength .

Power Potion.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Power cards to add ( two copies of it ) to your hand. It costs ( They cost ) 0 this turn.

Skill Potion.description: Choose 1 of 3 random Skill cards to add ( two copies of ) to your hand. It costs ( They cost ) 0 this turn.

Speed Potion.description: Gain 5 ( 10 ) Dexterity . At the end of your turn, lose 5 ( 10 ) Dexterity .

Blood Potion.description: Heal for 20% ( 40% ) of your Max HP.

Distilled Chaos.description: Play the top 3 ( 6 ) cards of your draw pile.

Duplication Potion.description: This turn, your next card is ( two cards are ) played twice.

Gambler's Brew.description: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.

Liquid Memories.description: Choose a card ( 2 cards ) in your discard pile and return it to your hand. It costs ( They cost ) 0 this turn.

Smoke Bomb.description: Escape from a non-boss combat. Receive no rewards.

Snecko Oil.description: Draw 5 ( 10 ) Cards . Randomize the cost of cards in your hand

Elixir.description: Exhaust any number of cards in your hand.

Entropic Brew.description: Fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.

Fairy in a Bottle.description: When you would die, heal to 30% ( 60% ) of your Max HP instead and discard this potion.

Essence of Darkness.description: Channel 1 ( 2 ) Dark for each orb slot.
